name: SVC_NOTIFY_CFG_EVENTS
description: This table is used to store the configuration of notification events.

columns.name: CFG_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: VIEW_OBJECT_CD
columns.description: The unique object code value obtained from appcomposer api

columns.name: STD_TXT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the smarttext base table SVC_STANDARD_TEXT_B

columns.name: EVENT_NAME
columns.description: The name of the event which is being triggered for this notification configuration.

columns.name: EVENT_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: The event name to be displayed in the UI

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: The description of the configured notification event.

columns.name: SUBJECT_TEMPLATE
columns.description: The template subject of the configured notification

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if the configured notification event is enabled.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether individual user can override admin notification preference.

columns.name: REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if the configured notification event is required.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
